description.zh: KMS实例提供商。目前取值仅支持Aliyun。
description.en: The provider of the KMS instance. Set the value to Aliyun.
The ID of the KMS instance that you want to enable.

description.zh: 设置双可用区下的一个交换机，并且该交换机至少有1个可用IP。
description.en: The vSwitch in the two zones. The vSwitch must have at least one available IP address.

description.zh: 为KMS实例设置专有网络VPC ID。
description.en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) that is associated with the KMS instance.

description.zh: 为KMS实例设置两个可用区。通过双可用区负载均衡，提高服务可用性与容灾能力。
description.en: The two zones for the KMS instance. Dual-zone deployment improves service availability and disaster recovery capabilities.

descriptions.zh:
- RAM用户或RAM角色调用该OpenAPI需要被授予的权限策略详情，请参见[访问控制](~~2767210~~)。

- 仅支持启用软件密钥管理实例，不支持启用硬件密钥管理实例。
descriptions.en:
### [](#)Limits

You can enable only instances of the software key management type. You cannot enable instances of the hardware key management type.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms connect-kms-instance --kms-instance-id kst-phzz64f722a1buamw00000 --vpc-id vpc-bp19z7cwmltad5dff0000 --zone-ids cn-hangzhou-k,cn-hangzhou-j --vswitchids vsw-bp1i512amda6d10a00000 --km-provider Aliyun --region cn-hangzhou
